description: Read, patch, and roll back one #id-addressed block of a document instead of rewriting the file.
name: io.github.geml-spec/geml

packageArguments.description: The one directory the server may read and write. Paths outside it are refused, including via ../, absolute paths, and symlinks. Use an absolute path: a relative one resolves against whatever working directory the client happens to start the server in.
packageArguments.name: --root

packageArguments.description: Optional code-graph directory inside --root, adding three read-only call-graph tools. Defaults to <root>/.geml-code-graph when that holds an index.geml; with no graph those tools are not served.
packageArguments.name: --graph
